2026_01_ARI_LAC.headline: Arizona’s protection injuries give the Chargers a path to dictate passing downs
2026_01_ARI_LAC.paragraph1: Arizona enters Los Angeles without starting guard Isaiah Adams and corner Garrett Williams, while rookie back Jeremiyah Love is a game-time decision. That puts extra weight on Jacoby Brissett, Trey McBride and the Cardinals’ early-down efficiency because obvious passing situations invite the Chargers to unleash pressure around Justin Herbert’s offense. Los Angeles still must handle Arizona’s defensive front, but the matchup tilts if the Chargers force long-yardage downs and make the Cardinals protect depleted edges and interior combinations.
2026_01_ARI_LAC.model_rationale: Los Angeles has multiple ways to stress Arizona’s weakened protection, while the Cardinals need efficient early downs and controlled tempo to keep that pressure from taking over.
